title: Grammar: make a plan for soon (review g16 and g15)
subtitle: Unit 14: Free time and simple plans

steps.title: make a plan for soon (review g16 and g15)
steps.body: Use the present of aller + infinitive for a plan. Add a day and time you already know: On va patiner dimanche à quinze heures.

steps.title: Use aller + an action in the infinitive
rows: I am going to listen to a concert.
You are going to play hockey.
On va à la cabane à sucre samedi.
We are going to the sugar shack on Saturday.

steps.prompt: We are going to skate Sunday.
steps.explain: With on, use va; keep the next verb in the infinitive patiner.

steps.prompt: I am going to watch a film.
steps.explain: With je, use vais and then the infinitive regarder.

steps.prompt: They are going to a concert.
steps.explain: With ils, use vont; à + le becomes au.

steps.prompt: Which question asks someone to go skating?
steps.explain: Use vouloir + infinitive: Tu veux aller patiner ?
